stemMd: What is the domain of f(x) = √(6 − 2x)?
explanationMd: For a real square root, 6 − 2x must be nonnegative. Solving −2x ≥ −6 gives x ≤ 3 after reversing the inequality. Equality is allowed because √0 exists.

distractorRationale.e: The square root is defined when the radicand is zero.
distractorRationale.d: Inputs greater than three give a negative radicand.
distractorRationale.c: Negative inputs can still give a positive radicand.
